The evidence suggests a possible regulatory or signaling mechanism where 2-methoxyestradiol could modulate the activity of the GABA-B receptor subunit, thereby affecting ZR-75-1. The integration of these targets highlights a potential role for 2-methoxyestradiol in modulating the function of ZR-75-1 via a receptor-mediated pathway.
